pathway.ordering_basis: Candidates are the target's primary related occupations, ordered by O*NET expert review; among them, steps are sequenced by similarity to the user's current skill profile, most achievable first.
pathway.skills_basis: Consecutive occupations on a pathway require very nearly the same skills (measured cosine 0.987-0.996), so each step lists the skills that matter most in that role by O*NET importance, badged as new to the user or as demanding more depth than the previous step.
